title: Grilled Ukrainian Pork Kebabs
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring marinated pork skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of your favorite vegetables or bread.

ingredients.name: Ukrainian bouncy bread, torn into 1-inch pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together nutty Ukrainian sauce, olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through.
Meanwhile, grill the torn Ukrainian bread pieces for 2-3 minutes per side, or until lightly toasted.
Serve the grilled pork skewers with the toasted bread on the side, and enjoy!
Note: Nutty Ukrainian sauce can be made by combining 1/4 cup of mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons of chopped fresh dill, and 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh parsley in a bowl.
